AC.H: source-specific complexity remains unknown unless explicitly mapped

AT.P: source-specific deployment/execution requirement remains unknown unless explicitly mapped

rules: AV:N does not mean Internet exposure.
PR:N does not mean authentication is disabled.
Do not replace attacker privileges with service-account privileges.
Do not infer exploit-specific AC/AT facts from a metric value.
Keep different CVSS assessments as alternatives with their own source and product scope.
Unknown, not applicable, mixed and missing answers never mean false.
A blocked known route does not establish product not_affected.
Network reachability records observed per-CVE access zones; it does not predict attacker location.
Unselected zones remain unknown. A selected zone requires CVE-relevant interface and access-type verification.

network_access.selection: zones:<ordered verified successful-connection zones> or allowed:<ordered rule-permitted zones>
network_access.negative: x requires verified complete inaccessibility across all listed zones and CVE-relevant paths
